name: Banking Transfer
description: Simulates a banking system with account transfers between hot accounts, balance checks, and audit trail logging. Tests contention handling, transaction integrity, and read/write mixing under realistic financial workload patterns.

setup_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bank_accounts (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), account_number STRING NOT NULL UNIQUE, holder_name STRING NOT NULL, balance DECIMAL(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00, currency STRING NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD', status STRING NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now())

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bank_transactions (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), from_account UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES bank_accounts(id), to_account UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES bank_accounts(id), amount DECIMAL(15,2) NOT NULL, currency STRING NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD', status STRING NOT NULL DEFAULT 'completed', description STRING, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), INDEX idx_txn_from (from_account), INDEX idx_txn_to (to_account), INDEX idx_txn_created (created_at DESC))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bank_audit_log (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), event_type STRING NOT NULL, account_id UUID, details JSONB, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), INDEX idx_audit_created (created_at DESC))
seed_sql: INSERT INTO bank_accounts (id, account_number, holder_name, balance) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), 'ACCT-' || generate_series::STRING, 'Account Holder ' || generate_series::STRING, 10000.00 + (random() * 90000)::DECIMAL(15,2) FROM generate_series(1, 50)

operations.name: transfer
sql: UPDATE bank_accounts SET balance = balance - $1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $2 AND balance >= $1
UPDATE bank_accounts SET balance = balance + $1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $3
INSERT INTO bank_transactions (from_account, to_account, amount, description) VALUES ($2, $3, $1, 'Transfer')

operations.name: balance_check
sql: SELECT a.account_number, a.holder_name, a.balance, a.currency, COUNT(t.id) as txn_count FROM bank_accounts a LEFT JOIN bank_transactions t ON t.from_account = a.id OR t.to_account = a.id WHERE a.id = $1 GROUP BY a.id, a.account_number, a.holder_name, a.balance, a.currency

operations.name: recent_transactions
sql: SELECT t.id, t.amount, t.currency, t.status, t.created_at, fa.account_number as from_acct, ta.account_number as to_acct FROM bank_transactions t JOIN bank_accounts fa ON fa.id = t.from_account JOIN bank_accounts ta ON ta.id = t.to_account ORDER BY t.created_at DESC LIMIT 20

operations.name: audit_log
sql: INSERT INTO bank_audit_log (event_type, account_id, details) VALUES ($1, $2, $3)

operations.name: total_balance_check
sql: SELECT currency, COUNT(*) as accounts, SUM(balance) as total_balance, AVG(balance) as avg_balance FROM bank_accounts WHERE status = 'active' GROUP BY currency
